mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PAID'), 0) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PAID') AS paid_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM payments

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS count FROM payments WHERE status = 'PAID' AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AND paid_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM payments GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(pay_method, '기타') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM payments WHERE status = 'PAID' GROUP BY pay_method ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT p.product_code AS slug, f.title AS title, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS count FROM payments p LEFT JOIN fortunes f ON f.slug = p.product_code WHERE p.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.product_code, f.title ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT COALESCE(f.title, r.slug) AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fortune_results r LEFT JOIN fortunes f ON f.slug = r.slug GROUP BY r.slug, f.title ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT c.category AS category, COALESCE(rev.revenue, 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(gen.gen_count, 0) AS gen_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT category FROM fortunes) c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fo.category, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN fortunes fo ON fo.slug = p.product_code WHERE p.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY fo.category ) rev ON rev.category = c.category LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fo.category, COUNT(*) AS gen_count FROM fortune_results r JOIN fortunes fo ON fo.slug = r.slug GROUP BY fo.category ) gen ON gen.category = c.category ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fortune_results GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT f.slug AS slug, f.title AS title, COALESCE(pd.paid, 0) AS paid_count, COALESCE(dn.done, 0) AS done_count FROM fortunes f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_code AS slug, COUNT(*) AS paid FROM payments WHERE status = 'PAID' GROUP BY product_code ) pd ON pd.slug = f.slug LEFT JOIN ( SELECT slug, COUNT(*) AS done FROM fortune_results WHERE status = 'DONE' GROUP BY slug ) dn ON dn.slug = f.slug WHERE COALESCE(pd.paid, 0) > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(dn.done, 0)::float / NULLIF(pd.paid, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members) AS total_members, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM payments WHERE status = 'PAID') AS paying_members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT member_id FROM payments WHERE status = 'PAID' GROUP BY member_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) t) AS repurchase_members, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM saju_history) AS free_saju_users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.member_id) FROM saju_history s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.member_id = s.member_id AND p.status = 'PAID')) AS free_saju_paid

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM members WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
SELECT CASE WHEN role = 'ROLE_ADMIN' THEN '관리자' ELSE '일반' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM members GROUP BY (role = 'ROLE_ADMIN') ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM saju_history WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(gender, ''), '미상') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM saju_history GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(gender, ''), '미상') ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(calendar, ''), '미상') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM saju_history GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(calendar, ''), '미상') ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN time_unknown THEN '시간모름' ELSE '시간입력' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM saju_history GROUP BY time_unknown ORDER BY count DESC
